questions.question: Is bringing my pet dinosaur to the interview a good idea?
questions.explanation: Probably not, unless the company specifically requested prehistoric transportation.
questions.answer: Leave your dinosaur safely at home and attend the interview by yourself.
questions.example: The recruiter will appreciate your qualifications more than your velociraptor.

questions.question: How many cups of coffee are too many before an interview? <strike style="background-color: rgb(144, 238, 144);">FUCCCCCCCCCCCKKKKKKKKKK</strike> 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥
questions.explanation: Enough that your handshake becomes a vibration test.
questions.answer: Stick to your normal amount and stay hydrated.
questions.example: One coffee: confident. Seven coffees: speed-running your introduction.

questions.question: What to become a waiter?💸💸💸 IDKKKKKKKKKKK
questions.explanation: Your brain occasionally enjoys dramatic entrances.
questions.answer: Take a deep breath, pause for a second, and answer one question at a time.
questions.example: Even saying 'That's a great question, let me think for a moment' is perfectly fine.

questions.question: The interviewer has a cooler keyboard than mine. Should I compliment it?
questions.explanation: A genuine compliment is fine if it fits naturally.
questions.answer: Keep compliments brief and move back to the interview.
questions.example: 'Nice mechanical keyboard! Anyway, regarding my experience...'

questions.question: Does every interview make me a better candidate? 💸
questions.explanation: Even the awkward ones teach valuable lessons.
questions.answer: Yes. Reflect on what went well and what can be improved.
questions.example: After every interview, write down three things you learned.

questions.question: Can I end the interview with finger guns and a wink?
questions.explanation: The app says no. Your future self agrees.
questions.answer: Thank the interviewer professionally and leave on a positive note.
questions.example: 'Thank you for your time. I really enjoyed our conversation and look forward to hearing from you.'
